_readme: Copy to demo-access.json (git-ignored) and fill in. Used by tools/capture and the PowerPoint speaker notes only — never by the website or PDF.

smc.why: Live production system with real client data.
path: Admin on a laptop: Dashboard → Calendar → Carry Forward → Task Config.

veloce.why: Shared production deployment; the admin account can change any yard.
path: Owner on a phone: Home → Inward → Sort → Sell.
Overview → Ask Clario → History → open a conversation.

city-threads.why: Demonstration accounts offered on the app’s own login screen.
path: Tap a role under “Demonstration access” on the login screen.

tribal-brew-coffee.why: Live production POS of a working café chain — view only.
path: Point of Sale → Sell → choose an outlet → open a completed bill.

lead-discovery-crm.why: A Crita team member’s own account.
path: Dashboard → Responses → open a response → Templates.

ai-sales-crm.why: One-click demo account on the app’s own sign-in screen.
path: Sign-in screen → Try Demo Account → Sign in.

expense-log.why: Shared demo backend; the admin account can change company data.
path: Administrator: Home → All Expenses → Budget Management → Report.

support-portal.why: The administrator account can change any ticket.
path: Administrator: All tickets → open the resolved ticket → History.
